name: factorio-rts
title: Factorio RTS
author: Kealman
description: Factorio as a StarCraft-style real-time strategy game. Command from a free camera with box selection, right-click orders, control groups and abilities, and build your army through a real Factorio economy: mining lines, factories, research, forward hubs and haulers. Skirmish: 15-30 minute matches against 1 to 3 AI commanders with their own doctrines on generated arenas. Nation: a mini-state on a world of up to 4096x4096 tiles with 2 to 6 nations. Found cities, feed and house their people, link them by rail, run a treasury and trade, go to war for goals, capture cities and race through three ages to a Space Program launch. Start a new Freeplay game and the RTS lobby opens. Space Age optional.
